libraries.name: SVT-AV1
libraries.license: BSD-3-Clause-Clear AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND MIT AND ISC
libraries.note: the encoder library only (static, no apps, no tests), built with cmake by crates/fin-svt-sys/build.rs: BSD-3-Clause-Clear, BSD-2-Clause (libaom- and dav1d-derived files), BSD-3-Clause (fastfeat), MIT (safestringlib, Source/Lib/Codec/vector.c), ISC (x264's x86inc.asm); the hashed files carry those texts (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md has them in full). crates/fin-svt-sys/csrc/svt_shim.c is Finisher's own (MIT)

libraries.name: dav1d
libraries.note: the decoder library only (static, 8- and 16-bit, no tools), compiled by crates/fin-dav1d-sys/build.rs with cc (no meson): BSD-2-Clause (VideoLAN and dav1d authors, Two Orioles, Martin Storsjo, Janne Grunau, The rav1e contributors and others, all with the COPYING text), ISC (x264's x86inc.asm, %included by the x86_64 assembly); the hashed files carry those texts (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md has them in full). crates/fin-dav1d-sys/csrc/dav1d_shim.c is Finisher's own (MIT)

libraries.name: libopus
libraries.note: the codec library only (float, static; celt_sources.mk CELT_SOURCES, silk_sources.mk SILK_SOURCES + SILK_SOURCES_FLOAT, opus_sources.mk OPUS_SOURCES + OPUS_SOURCES_FLOAT), compiled by crates/fin-opus-sys/build.rs with cc (no meson, cmake or autotools): no dnn/ or lpcnet sources (deep PLC, DRED and OSCE off), no SSE/AVX/NEON intrinsics or assembly files, no run-time CPU detection. BSD-3-Clause (Xiph.Org, Skype Limited, Octasic, Jean-Marc Valin, Timothy B. Terriberry, CSIRO, Gregory Maxwell, Mark Borgerding, Erik de Castro Lopo, Mozilla, Amazon; the COPYING text, which also points to the royalty-free IETF patent licences of Xiph.Org, Microsoft and Broadcom). crates/fin-opus-sys/shim/fin_opus_shim.c is Finisher's own (MIT)

libraries.name: vo-aacenc
libraries.note: release 0.1.3 (configure.ac) at upstream mstorsjo/vo-aacenc's last commit (2017-06-28, after the v0.1.3 tag), from Finisher's fork (spec §6.4). Linux only: the encoder library (fixed point, static; Makefile.am libvo_aacenc_la_SOURCES: common/cmnMemory.c, aacenc/basic_op, aacenc/src), compiled by crates/fin-aacenc-sys/build.rs with cc (no autotools) for Linux targets only; no ARMv5E/ARMv7 assembly, no example program. Apache-2.0 (VisualOn, Android Open Source Project; the COPYING text and the section 4(d) NOTICE). Its patent grant covers VisualOn's contributions only; AAC patent licensing is counsel item 6.1 (aacenc/patent_disclaimer.txt: no grant of patent rights). crates/fin-aacenc-sys/shim/fin_aacenc_shim.c is Finisher's own (MIT)

libraries.name: SQLite
libraries.note: the SQLite amalgamation bundled by libsqlite3-sys (rusqlite's `bundled` feature); SQLite 3.54.0, which has the WAL-reset fix (crates/fin-store/tests/sqlite_engine.rs); SQLite is in the public domain

libraries.name: ring

libraries.name: AWS-LC
libraries.license: ISC AND (Apache-2.0 OR ISC) AND Apache-2.0 AND MIT AND BSD-3-Clause AND (Apache-2.0 OR ISC OR MIT) AND (Apache-2.0 OR ISC OR MIT-0)
libraries.note: AWS-LC's bundled C and assembly, compiled by the crate's build script with its cc builder (no CMake); on Windows x64 the bundled `prebuilt-nasm` objects. `fin-registry` uses it through `aws-lc-rs` for TUF signatures and the editor's ed25519 keys (8A Decision 8)
